deposits.notes:
One Research Square record is counted as one deposit. Its public landing-page __NEXT_DATA__.props.pageProps.initialData.files manifest lists eight assets: the manuscript, five figure images, and two files whose role is supplement. All eight asset URLs returned HTTP 200; names and byte sizes are copied from this manifest and confirmed against downloaded byte counts. The two supplementary files are DataSPSS.sav (https://assets-eu.researchsquare.com/files/rs-8774138/v1/b9dc5dfe77302df009deb76e.sav; HTTP 200; 19,052 bytes) and researchtools.pdf (https://assets-eu.researchsquare.com/files/rs-8774138/v1/3acc7cbd716f70a28ba93383.pdf; HTTP 200; 429,951 bytes). The SAV URL is also the form's data_and_code.data_url. Research Square is not one of the repositories with a file-listing API specified in the brief; its publisher-provided JSON manifest was used for enumeration.

DataSPSS.sav was read entirely in memory using pyreadstat 1.3.3 and io.BytesIO. It has 113 rows and 28 columns. Exactly 112 rows contain participants; the remaining row has a blank Name value and all numeric fields missing. The 112 participant rows have 112 distinct Name values, paired first-/final-draft scores, and no narrative-text field. Personal name values are not reproduced here.

SPSS value labels for 组别 (Group) directly identify 1 = AI-first, 2 = AI-follow, 3 = AI-parallel, 4 = Human-only. Observed participant counts are respectively 28, 25, 30, and 29, matching the paper's p. 4 valid-case sample. All 112 participant rows contain every stored creativity score, group, age, gender, and pre-/post-test self-efficacy. These counts precede model-specific exclusions and are not the paper's final ANCOVA denominators.

English SPSS labels identify 初稿均 as Preliminary Draft Average and 终稿均 as Final Draft Average, followed by first-/final-draft fluency, flexibility, originality and elaboration scores. The corresponding ten D-prefixed columns are explicitly labeled Deepseek Evaluation. These are per-participant score summaries, not a table of the ten raters' individual ratings. The four DeepSeek dimensions average exactly to the stored overall scores; the four supplied human dimensions do not always average to the stored human overall scores. This does not resolve the missing human-score aggregation protocol.

There are no participant-flow, exclusion, Cook's-distance, analysis-inclusion, imputation-number or imputation-seed fields, and no analysis code or imputed-dataset files in the record. Eight participant rows have missing Creative Personality and AI I Literacy covariates, unlike the main paper's p. 7 statement that five participants had missing values. Thus the deposited file alone does not establish exact model-specific post-exclusion totals or arm counts, or the authors' multiple-imputation results.

All four pages of researchtools.pdf were read with PyMuPDF in memory. Page 1 supplies English/Chinese Group A first-draft task instructions and the writing prompt; pp. 2-4 supply partial creative-self-efficacy, creative-personality and AI-literacy questionnaires. It contains no completed participant narratives, outcome data, rater-level scores, scoring/aggregation protocol, analysis code, or additional links. Neither supplement supplies participant texts or ideas for diversity/homogenization measures.

The article and publisher metadata state CC BY 4.0. No separate supplementary-file-specific license statement was found; the license field describes the record-level license.

what_we_could_compute: Unadjusted first- and final-draft means, sample SDs and SEs by arm from the stored participant-level human and DeepSeek overall creativity and four subdomain scores. Unadjusted final-draft mean differences and contrasts directly address final.open_items[5] (sixth item). Any standardized contrast would require an explicitly chosen standardizer; the authors' unspecified Cohen's d calculation would remain unverified.

Observed-score counts by arm before model-specific exclusions: AI-first 28, AI-follow 25, AI-parallel 30, Human-only 29. The public data do not identify the published models' post-exclusion totals or arm counts requested in final.open_items[4] (fifth item).
notes:
Checked on 2026-10-09. The complete 44,706-character markdown conversion, including all figure captions, references and the p. 20 supplementary-file list, was read in three consecutive chunks. PDF pp. 1, 12 and 20 were checked directly with PyMuPDF, all PDF link annotations were examined, and the four-page researchtools.pdf supplement was read in full. The source is Research Square v1 (DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-8774138/v1); current publisher metadata lists only published version 1 and no version of record.

The DOI URL https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-8774138/v1 returned HTTP 200 after redirecting to the publisher landing page; that landing page also returned HTTP 200 directly. Both supplementary links and the five figure assets plus manuscript asset returned HTTP 200 without credentials. The p. 1 license link https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ returned HTTP 200. The form's earlier WinError 10013 access failure is resolved by these checks.

All twelve successful repository API searches in searches returned HTTP 200. DataCite's title-phrase query returned two unrelated records: Responsibility judgments in sequential human-AI collaboration (10.17605/osf.io/5ajzd) and Strategic and counterfactual reasoning in AI-assisted decision making (10.26204/kluedo/9284). The OSF title-phrase query returned the unrelated Responsibility judgments project v5c4u. DataCite's first-author query returned 19 records whose titles concern robotics/AI engineering, loess/water-air flow, or crystal structures; none concerns this narrative-creativity trial. The remaining successful searches returned zero results. No additional relevant deposit was identified. The OSF first-author search uses the prescribed node-title filter, so it searches the author's name in project titles, not contributor metadata.

The two Zenodo searches with size=100 returned HTTP 400, stating that anonymous requests permit page sizes up to 25; their counts and relevance are null. Both queries were rerun successfully with size=25 without logging in. Repeated identical API queries are consolidated. The publisher search's n_results=2 counts designated supplementary files; the deposit's n_files=8 counts all eight publisher-manifest assets.

No code-availability or preregistration statement for this trial was found. The p. 12 statement offers additional data on reasonable request, but public participant scores and arm labels are already confirmed, so the overall status is public_participant_data. The data do not settle original randomization/attrition counts, exact published-model exclusions, the evaluator used for the reported subdomain ANCOVAs, the complete human-rater aggregation protocol, or the authors' effect-size standardizer. The material supplement does not settle those issues. Text-based diversity measures cannot be computed because participant narratives/ideas are absent. No data were requested from the authors.
